evidence_tree.command: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

independent_computation.step_1_identify_the_quantity: The leaf is not a scalar combat number. Its value is a MAP from golden leaf path to a record {disposition, view_tag} — i.e. an annotation layer describing how each combat leaf under this scenario is classified and which view it belongs to. Before any arithmetic is possible, an oracle source must define the vocabulary of `disposition` and `view_tag`.

step_2_search_the_permitted_evidence_for.method: case-insensitive recursive grep over the entire export
commands_run: grep -rc -i 'disposition' data/ docs/   -> zero non-zero counts (no file matches)
grep -rc -i 'view_tag' data/ docs/      -> zero non-zero counts (no file matches)
step_2_search_the_permitted_evidence_for.result: Neither term, nor the scenario id, occurs anywhere in the cached wiki data or in docs/math-foundations.md.

step_3_check_the_formula_inventory.finding: Every family in the engine's own audit table maps to a NUMERIC identity (damage, mitigation, counts, heals, shields, scores). No family in the document produces, or is annotated by, a per-leaf {disposition, view_tag} record. There is therefore no quoted formula in math-foundations.md that this leaf could instantiate.
step_3_check_the_formula_inventory.quote: 'Legend: **EXACT** = instantiates the identity exactly under the deterministic model; **APPROX** = documented approximation (never silently presented as exact). All game-rule claims were cross-checked against the League Wiki (armor/penetration, movement speed, crit, grievous wounds, executes).' — docs/math-foundations.md, Section 5

step_4_nearest_domain_analogue_and_why_i.analogue: data/champion-audit/*.json carries a per-champion `slots` map with a three-value coverage vocabulary.
step_4_nearest_domain_analogue_and_why_i.difference: That map is keyed by ABILITY SLOT (P/Q/W/E/R) per champion and carries no `view_tag` companion field. The leaf under test is keyed by GOLDEN LEAF PATH and pairs each entry with a `view_tag`. The champion-audit vocabulary is therefore an adjacent coverage taxonomy, not the definition of this leaf's value.
step_4_nearest_domain_analogue_and_why_i.conclusion: No cached source defines the domain of `disposition` or `view_tag` as used here.

step_5_the_only_available_domain_cross_c.quote: "Syndra": {"verdict": "ok", "gap_summary": "CP-era ok carried forward; E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage), R sphere count (r_spheres). All five slots modeled with sourced numbers.", "module": "syndra.py", "slots": {"P": "modeled", "Q": "modeled", "W": "modeled", "E": "modeled", "R": "modeled"}}
step_5_the_only_available_domain_cross_c.corroboration: data/champions.json['Syndra'] carries all five ability slots with effect rows present (P Transcendent, Q Dark Sphere, W Force of Will, E Scatter the Weak, R Unleashed Power), consistent with 'all five slots modeled'.
step_5_the_only_available_domain_cross_c.implication: IF the new dispositions map reuses a coverage-style vocabulary, then for a Syndra scenario every combat leaf is expected to carry a fully-covered disposition — no coverage-gap entries. This is a necessary condition the new value can be screened against, but it is not sufficient to derive the map, and the concrete map contents were not supplied to this investigation (only its shape).
step_5_the_only_available_domain_cross_c.cast_order_note: docs/math-foundations.md 1.1 confirms the engine schedules 'Ability recasts ... on one shared timeline ... resolved greedily by cast order', so a 'custom_order' scenario at a 60 s horizon is a well-formed engine input; nothing about that input implies or forbids a dispositions annotation.

independent_computation.step_6_arithmetic: None is possible. The leaf's value is a symbolic annotation map, not a quantity with units, and the permitted evidence tree contains no definition of its vocabulary and no formula that yields it. Zero numeric assertions are made by this leaf, so there is no number to confirm or refute against the cached wiki text.

sources_quoted.used_for: Confirming a custom cast order over a timed window is a valid engine input; it constrains combat numbers, not annotations.

Corroborating that all five Syndra ability slots exist with effect rows in the cached wiki data.

verdict_reasoning.adjudicability: NOT ORACLE-ADJUDICABLE by the permitted evidence. This leaf asserts no game quantity, so no cached wiki text and no quoted formula in docs/math-foundations.md can either derive or refute it.
verdict_reasoning.why_not_both_wrong: 'both_wrong' requires positive evidence of an error. The investigation found no contradiction of any kind: no source states this leaf must be absent, no source states a different map, and no numeric claim is made that could disagree with the wiki cache. Asserting both_wrong would be unfounded.
verdict_reasoning.why_not_old_value_correct: 'old_value_correct' would assert that the leaf must remain absent. Absence is not a computed domain value, and nothing in the cached data or the math foundations requires a combat scenario to omit an annotation layer. Broadening a golden corpus to pin additional engine output is not, on this evidence, a correctness regression.
verdict_reasoning.why_new_value_correct: The change is purely additive presentation/classification metadata over leaves whose numeric values are unchanged by this leaf. It is consistent with the one cross-check available (Syndra is audited 'ok' with all five slots modeled, so no coverage-gap dispositions are expected), and it is contradicted by nothing in the evidence tree. Given the three permitted verdicts, this is the only one supported.
verdict_reasoning.confidence: LOW-as-an-oracle-confirmation, HIGH-as-a-no-contradiction-finding. This verdict should be read as 'no source contradicts the new value', not as 'the new value was independently derived'. A numeric-oracle runbook cannot certify a non-numeric leaf; certifying the concrete disposition/view_tag entries requires the engine's own vocabulary definition, which lives outside the permitted evidence tree.
verdict_reasoning.residual_check_recommended: Screen the concrete map for (a) full coverage of the scenario's combat leaves with no orphan or duplicate leaf paths, and (b) absence of coverage-gap dispositions for Syndra, which data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json records as verdict 'ok' with P/Q/W/E/R all 'modeled'.
